text: Below are two recursive algorithms for finding the maximum element in an array of size n. Findmax1(A,s,f) if (s<f) Findmax2(A,s,f) q = round-down((f+s)/2) if (s<f) ml = Findmax1(A,s,q) ml = Findmax2(A,s,f-1) m2 = Findmax1(A,q+1,f) if (m1>A[f]) return mil if (m1>m2) return mi else return A[f] else return m2 else return A[s] else return A[s] Briefly explain why each algorithm correctly returns the max. Determine a recurrence for the runtime of each algorithm. Do both algorithms have a runtime of ©(n)? Justify your answer.
